deploy-bot: Deploy queued — release v1.8.2-patch.2026-03-19 (tag: rwd/v1.8.2-p1) -> staging (eu-west), canary 5% starting now. Commit: abcdef1234567890. Change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. No DB migrations. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m if checks pass. Rollback: `rwdctl deploy rollback --tag rwd/v1.8.2-p1`.

sofia: @sofia oncall — I can watch dashboards. Which metrics are the gating checks? cpu / latency / 5xx / eval quality?

raj: Gates are: 95th latency threshold, 5xx error rate, embedding throughput, and our quality eval (`infra_smoke_v2`). We also pinned the served model to `redwood/opt-3B@v2.1-quant` for this patch.

mike: Quick Q — are we routing canary traffic via the ab-test route or stable-api? Need to pin to `route=stable-api` for this run.

lia: :thumbsup: Kicked off synthetic traffic against the canary at 1 rps/replica. Will post run summary in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Status: 5% healthy so far. Checks running: latency(95th)=130ms -> target <150ms, 5xx=0.03% (ok), eval pass rate=97%. CI build #4821. Artifact checksum: sha256:deadbeefcafebabefeedface. Logs: `kubectl -n rwd rollout status deploy/rwd-inference-eu-west`

raj: Confirmed no DB schema or config migrations. Also pinning `inference.batch_size=4` in runtime config for this release to avoid perf regressions.

sofia: FYI Sentry had tokenization spikes earlier today but those were noise from a test job — still watching though.

lia: Synthetic run looks stable. Tail latency had a single spike on pod-7, HPA recycled it and metrics returned to normal. No 5xx.

mike: If anything degrades, we'll run rollback to previous tag: `rwdctl deploy rollback --tag rwd/v1.8.1` and open an incident. I'll be standing by.

deploy-bot: Canary checks passed. Promoting to 25% now. Progress note: continuous canary verification in place (latency/errs/eval).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — 100% rollout to staging/eu-west. All automated checks green. Next scheduled action: promote to prod-canary at 2026-03-20T01:00:00Z (within change window). Release notes (snippet): "Fix batching edge-case causing trailing tokens; improve kv-cache reuse; adjust decoder prefetch for quant paths."

sofia: Copy that. I'll increase logging verbosity and add a temp alert threshold for the next hour.

raj: Preparing prod rollout checklist and capacity reservation with infra. Will pin the rollback commands and tagging in the playbook.

deploy-bot: Monitoring window scheduled and this thread is being used as the coordination channel. If rollback is required, please call it out here and execute `rwdctl deploy rollback --tag <target-tag>`. Thread closed by deploy-bot.
